name: chuanho-next
description: Chùa Nhỏ: gõ mõ, thắp hương, check-in khẩu nghiệp và Lofi Đài, app giải trí mobile-first

scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 && pnpm check:brand && pnpm check:tokens && pnpm check:gentle
scripts.check:brand: check-brand --config brand.config.json --dir apps --dir packages --dir scripts --skip-dir dist --skip-dir test-results --skip-dir playwright-report --skip-dir generated --skip-dir decoders --source-file '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs|css|html)$' --code-file '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$' --test-file '(^|/)(e2e|test)/|\.(test|spec)\.tsx?$' --jsx-text --html-word --skip-comment-lines --ignore-marker 'check-brand-ignore:' --colour-dir apps/web/src --token-file apps/web/src/ui/tokens.css --hint 'read it from apps/web/src/brand.ts'
